guidance.CRITICAL: Immediate life threat. Continuous monitoring. Physician evaluation required immediately (0 min, immediate bay allocation).
guidance.HIGH: Emergent condition. High deterioration probability. Physician assessment required within 15-30 minutes.
guidance.MODERATE: Urgent condition requiring diagnostic investigation. Evaluation within 60 minutes.
guidance.LOW: Non-urgent ambulatory condition. Routine clinic assessment within 120 minutes.

redFlags.INF_QSOFA_GE_2: Infection/Sepsis: qSOFA >= 2 observed (RR >= 22, SBP <= 100, or altered mentation)
redFlags.RESP_RR_EXTREME: Respiratory: Extreme respiratory rate (RR > 32 or < 8 bpm)
redFlags.CARD_CHEST_PAIN: Cardiac: Crushing retrosternal chest pain radiating to jaw/left arm
redFlags.CARD_SYNCOPE: Cardiac: Syncope accompanied by chest pressure
redFlags.CARD_HR_EXTREME: Cardiac: Extreme heart rate (HR > 150 or < 40 bpm)
redFlags.NEURO_FOCAL_DEFICIT: Neurological: Acute focal deficit (facial droop, arm drift, slurred speech)
redFlags.BP_HYPERTENSIVE_CRISIS: Blood Pressure: Hypertensive crisis (SBP > 180 or DBP > 120 with headache/chest pain)
redFlags.DIAB_HYPOGLYCEMIA: Diabetes: Severe hypoglycemia (CBG < 60 mg/dL with altered consciousness)
redFlags.DIAB_DKA: Diabetes: Severe hyperglycemia (CBG > 400 mg/dL with ketotic breathing)
redFlags.GI_GUARDING: Gastrointestinal: Involuntary abdominal guarding or rigidity
redFlags.TRAUMA_SPINAL: Trauma: Suspected acute spinal cord injury
redFlags.PREG_HEMORRHAGE: Pregnancy: Third-trimester vaginal hemorrhage (gestational age > 20 wks)
redFlags.PREG_ECLAMPSIA_AURA: Pregnancy: Severe epigastric pain with visual aura (pre-eclampsia)
redFlags.ALLERGY_ANGIOEDEMA: Allergy: Angioedema of tongue or pharynx
redFlags.DEHYD_COLD_EXT_CAP_REFILL: Dehydration: Cold extremities with capillary refill time > 4 seconds
redFlags.VITAL_HR_CRITICAL: Vital Baseline: Critical heart rate (< 40 or > 150 bpm)
redFlags.VITAL_RR_CRITICAL: Vital Baseline: Critical respiratory rate (< 8 or > 32 bpm)
redFlags.VITAL_SBP_CRITICAL: Vital Baseline: Critical systolic blood pressure (< 85 or > 180 mmHg)
redFlags.VITAL_DBP_CRITICAL: Vital Baseline: Critical diastolic blood pressure (> 120 mmHg)
redFlags.VITAL_SPO2_CRITICAL: Vital Baseline: Critical oxygen saturation (< 90% on room air)
redFlags.VITAL_TEMP_CRITICAL: Vital Baseline: Critical body temperature (< 35.0°C or > 40.0°C)
redFlags.VITAL_CBG_CRITICAL: Vital Baseline: Critical capillary blood glucose (< 60 or > 400 mg/dL)
